ios.desc:
Build habits that actually stick, with an AI coach in your pocket.

Habit AI is a simple daily habit tracker with a built-in AI habit coach. Choose what you want to change and get a starter plan in seconds. Then check off your habits, grow your streaks and watch your progress add up.

WHY HABIT AI
• AI habit coach: get personalized habit suggestions and an analysis of your progress, so you always know what to adjust next.
• Instant starter plans: answer a few quick questions and start with a ready-made routine built around your goal.
• One-tap templates: add habits from ready-made templates with a single tap.
• Streaks that motivate: watch your chain grow day after day and keep the momentum going.
• Reminders: set a reminder for each habit at the time that suits you.
• Calendar and stats: review every day in the calendar and follow your progress with clear statistics.
• Home screen widget: see and check off today's habits without opening the app.
• Discover: take personality and self-discovery tests to learn what drives you.
• iCloud backup: back up your habits and history to iCloud and restore them anytime.
• Available in 19 languages.

GREAT FOR
Morning and evening routines, self-care, workouts, reading, studying, drinking more water, a steadier sleep schedule, quitting a bad habit and building discipline, one small step at a time.

PLANS
• Free: track up to 7 habits.
• Premium (monthly or annual): unlimited habits plus the full AI habit coach. The annual plan starts with a 7-day free trial, and the app reminds you before your trial ends.
• Lifetime: a one-time purchase that unlocks the habit tracking features for good. AI features are not included.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
